title: Hero section (Flipping flexbox)
instructions:
Goal: Layout with a vertical axis

We have a large header banner prepared, containing a heading, text, and a button. We want to push this content into the bottom right corner.

  • Wrap the (.hero-banner) to a flexbox.
  • Since we want the elements to go one under another, rotate the main axis to a column.
  • Push this entire column all the way to the bottom.
  • Align the content to the right side.
  • Add a gap of 15px between the texts and the button.

checks.message: Banner must be set as Flexbox.
Flexbox normally places items side-by-side. Rotate the axis to a column.
checks.studentHint: The elements are arranged one under another in a column.

checks.message: Because you rotated the axis to a column, justify-content now handles the vertical displacement. Push it all the way down using a pure flex value.
checks.studentHint: The content is pushed all the way to the bottom.

checks.message: Now we need to align the content to the right side. In a vertical Flexbox, a special property is used for this.
checks.studentHint: The content is aligned to the right edge.

checks.message: Don't forget the gap! Add a gap with a size of 15px.
checks.studentHint: Elements have a 15px gap between them.
